definitions.full: H2781. cherpah חֶרְמָּה noun feminine reproach — ׳ח Gen 34:14 35t.; construct חֶרְמַּת Josh 5:9 15 t.; suffix חֶרְמָּֽתְךָ Psa 74:22 etc. + 17 t. suffixes; plural חֲרָפוֺת 69:11 ; Dan 12:2 ; construct חֶרְמּוֺת Psa 69:10 . — 1 taunt of enemy 1Sam 17:26 ; so also 25:39 ; reproach cast upon another, scorn, contumely Nehemiah 3:36; Neh 5:9 ; Psa 69:20 ; 69:21 ; 71:13 ; 89:51 ; 119:22 ; Prov 18:3 ; Isa 51:7 ; Ezekiel 21:33; ח ׳שׁמע Jer 51:51 ; Zeph 2:8 ; Lam 3:61 ; ח ׳נתן על Jer 23:40 ; ח ׳נשׂא על Psa 15:3 (slander); ח ׳נשׂא Jer 31:19 ; Ezek 36:15 ; Micah 6:16 (reproach); ׳ח על נשׂא bear reproach for Psa 69:8 ; Jer 15:15 ; Zeph 3:18 ; ח ׳השׁיב Hosea 12:15; Nehemiah 3:36; ח ׳חרף Psa 69:10 ; 79:12 ; 89:51 ; ח ׳הסיר מעל 1Sam 17:26 ; Isa 25:8 ; ח ׳העביר Psa 119:39 ; reproaches against God 69:10 ( חוֺרְפֶיךָ חֶרְמּוֺת ), 74:22 ; 79:12 . 2 reproach which rests upon one, condition of shame, disgrace: a. sexual 2Sam 13:13 ; Isa 47:3 ; Ezek 16:57 ; Prov 6:33 . b. barrenness of womb Gen 30:23 (E) Isa 4:1 ; widowhood 54:4 . c. hunger Ezek 36:30 ; disease Job 19:5 . d. ritual, uncircumcision Gen 34:14 (P) Josh 5:9 (JE). e. injuries from enemies Lam 3:30 ; 5:1 ; Neh 1:3 ; 2:7 ; Job 16:10 ; Dan 11:18 (twice in verse). 3 a reproach , the object of reproach, the person of thing reproached אָדָם חֶרְמַּת a reproach of man Psa 22:7 ; ׳ח נבל 39:9 ; ח ׳היה ׳ל become an object of reproach to 31:12 ; 79:4 ; 89:42 ; 109:25 ; Ezek 5:15 ; (ל לח ׅ׳(היה) Isa 30:5 ; Jer 6:10 ; 20:8 ; 42:18 ; 44:8 , 12 ; 49:13 ; Psa 69:11 ; Dan 9:16 ; 12:2 ; ח ׳נתן ׅ׳(ל Ezek 22:4 ; Joel 2:19 ; Psa 78:66 ; לח ׳נתן Jer 24:9 ; 29:18 ; Ezek 5:14 ; Josh 2:17 ; ח ׳שׂים ׳ל Psa 44:14 ; ח ׳שׂים על 1Sam 11:2 .
